# Notice

This project is a modern Fortran translation of computational routines from the R package **Rfast 2.1.5.2** by Manos Papadakis, Michail Tsagris, Marios Dimitriadis, Stefanos Fafalios, Matteo Fasiolo, Morgan Jacob, Giorgos Borboudakis, John Burkardt, Changliang Zou and contributors.

The translation is not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream authors. Original source and package metadata are preserved under `upstream/`.

The RNG layer uses the separately translated `zigg` package under `vendor/zigg-fortran/`; its attribution is retained there.
